$comment: C11/C23 6.7.5 + 6.7.6.2 (D-CSUBSET-ALIGNAS-OVERALIGNED-STACK-LOCAL x D-CSUBSET-VLA): an `alignas(32)` FIXED local in a function that also declares a VLA — the one interaction the over-aligned-local mechanism has with the rest of the frame. A VLA function moves SP at run time, so its fixed frame is addressed off the FRAME POINTER; the address rounding must ride that base and its `align - stackAlignment` bound must survive the substitution (the frame pointer is a copy of a stack-aligned SP, so it carries the same guarantee). LEAF by construction: a VLA function that CALLS anything is separately refused (L_VlaNonLeafFrameUnsupported, D-CSUBSET-VLA-NONLEAF-CALL-FRAME), so a sink call would measure that refusal instead of this interaction. Checks the VLA's first and last elements, the over-aligned local's own bytes, its 32-alignment, and an ordinary neighbouring local. exit = 42. Red-on-disable: zero `frameSlotAlignHeadroom` or drop the `emitAlignUpToPowerOfTwo` call in `emitLeaFrameSlot` and this returns 1. One exit code across all four targets incl. the shipped release pipeline.
